statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON / green. Monday’s technology-led record close remains important context, but sufficiently current granular NQ price-path evidence after the Globex reopen is unavailable, so Tail remains below WATCH.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because fresh persistent no-retracement structure is not verified; the next concentrated conditional risk window is Tuesday’s 13:30–15:30 UTC cash-open and Fed-speaker sequence.
headline: Tail returns to low overnight as strong prior-session momentum lacks verified fresh continuation structure
body: Monday ended with a record Nasdaq close, a 4.3% semiconductor-index gain, lower long Treasury yields and sharply lower crude. Those conditions are supportive context but do not establish a live one-way NQ path after the reopen. With current granular pullback/extension evidence unavailable, Stress remains extreme while Tail stays low.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail moved from low overnight into elevated/high through the U.S. session, peaked at 38% in power hour, dropped to low during the maintenance interruption, and returned to WATCH after the Globex reopen before easing to 21% by 23:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 19% / low because Monday’s one-way strength is not verified as persisting in fresh post-reopen NQ structure. Overnight Tail stays low-to-WATCH absent repeated extension or failed retracements. The principal conditional danger window is 13:30–15:30 UTC around the cash open and Williams/Jefferson sequence; Barkin and power hour are later checkpoints.
